answer_summary: Tick the bottom-right (seventh) choice: trans-[Fe(kappa4-N4-ligand 8)Cl2], a six-coordinate octahedral complex with four equatorial N donors and two trans axial chlorides.
assumptions: Problem input: the Q8-1 ligand-8 drawing contains four pyridyl nitrogen donor atoms.
Problem input: Q8-2 prints aquation of 1 with loss of two chloride ions, fixing two coordinated chlorides in 1.
Trusted general coordination chemistry: the conjugated quaterpyridine donor set binds kappa4 in the equatorial plane of the six-coordinate Fe-N4Cl2 octahedral sphere.
